reviews.author: Joanna B
reviews.comment:
Our stay at the Salt of Palmar has to be one of the most outstanding and memorable ones due to the excellent team of people that made our stay exceptional.   We observed these same service behaviours with each and every guest in this boutique, Design group hotel.

So what makes the difference?

It's the 'no reception desk' barrier - instead a human face to face interaction that is genuine and welcoming.

It's the well crafted design of the hotel with an infinity pool at really blends with the ocean.

It's the food and beverage team's attention to detail and excellent cuisine that set's the bar very high.     They love what they do and the standards are set and encouraged by Rikish who is inspirational and leads the team with confidence and a wealth of experience.

It's the feeling and vibe that is conveyed making it extremely hard to leave!

Thank you to all for making the magic.Read more

reviews.author: Tanishta
reviews.comment:
Our stay at Salt of Palmar was a truly remarkable experience, made even more special by the incredible team and unique offerings that set this place apart.

A standout feature was our time in the Himalayan Salt Room. This was our first experience, and it was absolutely incredible. Relaxing in this serene space not only helped us unwind but also offered noticeable health benefits like improved breathing and a sense of calm. It was a one-of-a-kind experience we will always remember and highly recommend to anyone visiting Salt of Palmar.

The team at the hotel deserves endless praise. Juliana’s spa treatments were pure magic—her expertise and care left us feeling utterly rejuvenated.

Sanjay played a key role in helping us choose the perfect meals. His deep knowledge of the menu and understanding of our preferences made every dining experience flawless.

Vikash welcomed us with an exclusive and warm PR touch, ensuring we felt like royalty throughout our stay.

Chef Shiva personally checked in during each meal to ensure we loved the food. He graciously took our feedback as valuable input, showing his commitment to delivering culinary excellence. His passion for his craft shone through every dish.

Mr. Dharam, with his vibrant and enthusiastic energy, made every moment a joy. His lively and cheerful service elevated our overall experience.

Salt of Palmar is not just a hotel—it’s a destination that redefines hospitality. The personalized care, thoughtful experiences like the Himalayan Salt Room, and the dedication of the entire team made our stay unforgettable. We’re already looking forward to our next visit!Read more

reviews.author: Ilyas A
reviews.comment:
We spent little over a week for our honeymoon at salt of palmar - although upon arrival checkin was little less than what we imagined the team made up for it with their attentive service and helpfulness - the quality of the food is one of the most unique points of the hotel - locally sourced organic ingredients used for high quality fresh meals. 
The management team are so alert and friendly and tended to our every need they always made it a point to think of solutions pragmatically - I want to especially thank Rishi for being very professional and helpful in helping with making up for the checkin hassle we faced - the hotel went really above and beyond for us! And we really felt the genuine care a special thanks to Sanjay who always had a smile and made us feel like we were getting extra care! Very funny and welcoming guy! 
The hotel also offered us a discounted couples spa treatment I have to admit Juliana was really good with the firm massage to get through my knots and put me to sleep! 
We’re so glad we decided to come to Mauritius in comparison to the other Indian Ocean islands - the Mauritian people were really warm hearted and kind to us everywhere we went.Read more

reviews.author: kcabsolutely1965
reviews.comment:
Where to start? 
First impressions: a grand looking entrance greets you along with staff greeting you with a hand on heart bowed welcome, your first encounter on how lovely all the staff are going to be during your visit. 
As you step through the door, you can see that pretty much 'every' aspect & item has been designed to be 'Instagramable'... you WILL photograph everything during your stay!!! The place is stunning. 
Rooms: We chose beachfront rooms and were not disappointed with the views. Huge 'very open' walk-in showers are a nice touch, quirky colours and touches throughout the room with big comfortable bed & pillows. 
Food & Bar: We were intrigued how the 'All Inclusive' option works as SALT have no buffet, everything including breakfast you order individually from a menu, the idea being no waste. This actually works very well although a 9-day stay exhausts most choices & suggest taking advantage of the daily specials throughout your stay at lunch & dinner. Service is interesting, as mentioned the staff are all fantastic & loveable but our experience found that many of our orders would be lost in translation somewhere between us, the waiter, the chef, the bar, no great mishaps just 'quirky' liveable/ rectifiable ones that weirdly just added to the whole charm of the place... like it wasn't really trying to be 5 star perfect but being that cool boutiquey place you just chill in. 
Beach: White sands, plenty of beds with  beautiful views & towels aplenty. Boat House with again nice friendly helpful staff for your water sport needs, highly recommend the free daily boat trip out to Snorkel in the coral. 
Pool & Roof Bar: Take a look at the photos... picture perfect. 
Spa: We all enjoyed a 60 minute treatment each designed to our individual needs, the experience ends with a relaxing chill in their SALT room, salt crystal floor, illuminated colour changing solid salt brick work surrounds you. 
Negatives: Not really. Personally I would suggest that both the food menu & bar menu financially doesn't need so many * items (i.e not included in all-inclusive)  e.g being a small or large draft lager is included but a small draft ale/beer is not? 
Positives: Stunning modern design with loveable staff making your stay a very enjoyable one!!
Thank you.
